description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time synchronization, timezone handling, and event subscriptions via JSON-RPC in a plugin environment. It includes methods for updating time status, timezone, handling events, and parsing timezone transition data.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class that manages system time synchronization, timezone updates, and event handling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SystemTime object, starting the event loop thread, and triggering initialization.

methods.name: ~SystemTime
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources, unsubscribes from events, and joins the event thread.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the system time is currently available.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds and its accuracy.

methods.name: onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the system time status changes.

methods.name: onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the timezone or DST status changes.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a JSON-RPC link to the system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to system time and timezone change events via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries the system link for current time status and updates internal state.

methods.name: UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Queries the system link for current timezone and accuracy, updating internal state.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone string and transition map to determine current offset and accuracy.

methods.name: PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates the transition map for timezone changes by parsing zdump output.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing queued events such as initialization, time status updates, timezone updates, and shutdown.
